label: Bounded investigation of candidate arist met 993b principles uncaused in being
summary:
Bounded investigation of candidate ARIST-MET-993B-PRINCIPLES-UNCAUSED-IN-BEING. Reused the attribution uniqueness, restricted causal comparative, order-not-first-being and first-mover-first-being types and maximal cause-exclusion type; no new maximality countermodel or vocabulary. Materialized/read ARIST-MET-II-1 (993b24–31) and newly pinned AQUINAS-IN-METAPH-II-L2 in full. In Metaph II lect2 n7 [81861] makes the principles’ uncausedness a reason for maximal truth rather than deriving uncausedness from qualified synonymy. N8 [81862] supplies participation/essence reasoning for separated substance as cause of corporeal substance, without establishing the separated principle’s lack of cause or identity with the unique primary analogate. N6 [81860] invokes common name/ratio of truth, not an unrestricted cause-more-being rule. N11 [81865] announces a following regress argument rather than delivering it in this passage. Exact findings and rejected readings are preserved in docs/being-not-a-genus.md, Uncaused principles. No claim, proof, premise substitution or philosophical discharge is added; root-premise delta 0. Queue audit2026-10-31: removed exhausted source candidate ARIST-MET-993B-PRINCIPLES-UNCAUSED-IN-BEING. Its named source contexts have been read and the available conditional interfaces inspected; the remaining semantic/applicability obligation is preserved here and in the linked note. This retires repeated ingestion, not the open premise; no closure or root-premise change.

BEING_4 DECLARATION/CONSUMER REUSE AUDIT (2026-11-09, baseline 25a2651c8f272642842f1538f32bf177116e8c06; shared conventions sourceRevision625cb04ca568aebc8d45c90033e107a05e9bd2a0): Inspected the five added target dossiers, related matches, the exact consuming context for QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-GENUS-PRINCIPLE-AT-BEING, Article3QuartaViaOrder definitions, its Solution and registered Order models, the being-graded-by-approach exploration and the existing being-not-a-genus note. DEF-BEING-ANALOGICAL and sense BEING_4 still lack a faithful full Lean body. The three sourced semantic statements BEING-SAID-PROS-HEN, BEING-FIRST-ANALOGICAL-PREDICATE and DIVINE-NAMES-ANALOGICAL likewise have no Lean declarations. No original allowance is completed by this audit.

Exact separation: ApproachToPrimaryReading is primary possession plus a biconditional between MoreIn and a supplied near-map strict preorder; it neither interprets diverse rationes nor supplies any cause. OrderedToPrimaryAsCauseReading is the separate universal creature/possession-to-CausesIn clause. The consuming theorem attributionOrderGenusPrincipleAtBeing takes these two, StrictPrimacyReading, OthersAreCreaturesReading and ExcludedMiddle explicitly. It identifies a maximum with the same supplied primary before applying the causal clause. No inspected theorem body infers the causal clause from semantic focality. Existing docs/being-not-a-genus.md already rejects Aristotle pros hen as this causal ordering, since affection, way and privation need not be productive causes. The broad being-univocity resolution and original mixed definition are interpretation promises, not additional Lean consequences; their present order models leave the semantic promise unfinished.

Reuse rather than duplicate: TruthCore.Models.Order.NoCausalOrder.evaluation0/1/3 hold approach, strict primacy and other-creature coverage on the SAME Bool/Unit/primary/near dictionary, while evaluation2/4 deny the causal clause and the maximum-causes-all conclusion. Both individuals possess the perfection, so this is not an empty-domain or empty-possession example. The consuming Solution's withoutCausalOrderFails proves the corresponding omission failure. Its withoutStrictPrimacyFails retains a real causal edge to the other creature but permits a tied noncausal maximum. HomogeneousScaleReading and ApproachToPrimaryReading can share an order under the additional universal-possession condition (homogeneousLift); therefore order shape does not establish sameness of defining account or diverse focal meanings. These controls do NOT contain interpreted rationes, reference-to-substance roles or a semantic focality certificate; they must not be advertised as models of full Aristotle pros hen, full Aquinas analogy, or failure of degree comparability from that semantics. The exact semantic same-carrier/same-primary focality-versus-cause/comparability cell remains UNTESTED.

Rejected shortcuts: binding BEING_4 to a bare related predicate, a homogeneous scalar, ApproachToPrimaryReading, OrderedToPrimaryAsCauseReading, their alias or their conjunction would omit diversity of defining accounts and the account of their focal relation. A semantic label or a false/true flag would only relocate the target. Composing q.6 a.2 with the causal root interface is already recorded as instantiation/transcription in ATTEMPT-REJECTED-DERIVATION-LEADS-20261107. Existing participation/distinct-esse/external-cause chains are not repeated. No new independent non-transcription root inference or faithful full declaration was identified in this bounded inventory; no new library, sense, premise or blocker-only PR is introduced.

Next discriminating cell: first interpret multiple defining accounts and their actual role-specific dependence on a primary (including nonproductive affection/privation roles), keeping the primary substance reading separate from a divine cause of esse. A mere enumeration of role names is not that interpretation. On one populated carrier and fixed dictionary, test focal predication with no productive cause and independently with incomparable approach degrees; only then test explicit applicability bridges to the existing causal and approach interfaces. Those bridges must add their causal/degree content openly, not derive it from the word analogy, and must reach the named consuming argument. The wider full original definition additionally needs the predication-reduction and God/creature applications, so certifying this one future cell alone will not complete BEING_4. Retain focal, univocal and unrelated-equivocal candidates without asserting exhaustive/exclusive coverage or asking the owner for a metaphysical winner. No new source reading or attribution was performed; all source locators and rejected readings above are reused findings. No proof input, semantic binding, claim/type, premise truth or root closure changes; this is local inventory persistence only. Existing verification evidence is reused, not rerun as new certification.
